content.text: Governing law and venue match the preferred position exactly, with no arbitration provisions anywhere in the document.

input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement and each dispute arising from it are governed by the laws of the State of New York, without regard to conflict-of-law principles. The United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods does not apply.
input.rationale: Section 28 matches our preferred position exactly: § 28.1 selects the laws of the State of New York (with CISG disclaimed), and § 28.2 gives the state and federal courts in New York County, New York exclusive jurisdiction, with mutual submission to personal jurisdiction and waiver of venue/forum objections. A document-wide search returned no arbitration provision, so there is no offshore arbitration seat or competing foreign venue despite the counterparty being a UK Ltd. The § 28.2 carve-out for temporary injunctive relief in another competent court and the § 28.3 pre-filing executive escalation are mutual, standard, and expressly do not delay urgent relief or limitations-period filings, so neither disadvantages us. No redline required.
